findings: A single authenticated later SACK is accepted only for an explicitly enabled saturated train12 window with fresh DATA still queued.
The caller must independently prove live original authority, exact physical DATA drain, matching host/worker inventory and no due ordinary RTO before the offer.
The first offer enters the existing bounded repair train; later holes remain one per normal host step and the train can contain no more than its admitted frame count.
Ordinary non-train12 flows retain the three-distinct-later-SACK rule and terminal recovery retains its original-FINAL proof.
Every repair still passes the owner, cipher, journal, native queue, original deadline and scheduler accounting path without changing byte or sequence state.
The paired source model reduces elapsed time by 1.079100 to 1.269100 seconds across seven- and nine-hole loss controls with identical attempt counts.
The seven-hole control retains the same two pre-existing ACK/DATA model collisions in both arms; the nine-hole control has zero collisions.
limitations: This is source evidence, not a physical RF result.
The source model excludes real process startup, CPU, fsync and native receive priority.
The motivating physical run11 remains diagnostic until its post-readback and reviewed result exporter complete.
Alpha 4 publication still requires fresh finite device trials, repeatable at least 2800 B/s evidence and intact verification/closure.
review_scope: Root source review and complete local regression suite; independent-agent acceptance remains a separate governance gate.
